documents.title: DLI Generative AI Hub
documents.quality_note: Hub page with GenAI definition, risk framing and a requirement to follow the Guidelines for Responsible Use of AI; the guidelines themselves are not in this text.

notes: The 'Guidelines for Responsible Use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) at USF' (usf.service-now.com KB15409) is the referenced university guideline, but the portal needs JavaScript and the fetch returned only a browser-support message: inaccessible. myusf.usfca.edu/node/3235569 and /node/3209408 (seen in search results) are 404. Excluded as generic: ITS AI Hub tool matrix (v2-san-francisco-its-hub), USF TEAch syllabus-statement link list (v2-san-francisco-teach), both fetched. No CS department or School of Arts & Sciences AI policy found in searches (Rhetoric & Language Dept has an AI policy listed on the TEAch page, but it is not computing). Course syllabi deferred.
